name: WA · Inbound
description: Receives verified WhatsApp webhooks from the gate, logs and routes every message.

parameters.query: select crm.ingest_inbound($1::jsonb) as state, $2::jsonb as event

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [ JSON.stringify({ wa_message_id: $json.event.waMessageId, phone: $json.event.from.phone, bsuid: $json.event.from.bsuid,
         profile_name: $json.event.from.profileName, username: $json.event.from.username, type: $json.event.type,
         body: $json.event.body,
         payload: { text: $json.event.text, media: $json.event.media, location: $json.event.location,
                    reply: $json.event.reply, context_id: $json.event.contextId, referral: $json.event.referral } }), JSON.stringify($json.event) ] }}
